name: coreutils-small-10

canonical_bridge_members.reason: Retain only GNU cksum_crc.c as a typed canonical bridge so glibc runtime CPU feature selection and PCLMUL/AVX2/AVX512 dispatch remain exact; translate cksum.c, sum.c and crctab.c and prove no other canonical cksum member enters the hybrid.

c_normalization.reason: Check every digest operand eagerly before explicitly accumulating its Boolean result.
Make both nonnegative read-count conversions to intmax_t explicit at checked-add boundaries.

deferred_configuration.reason: The canonical stat translation unit directly compiles SELinux headers, runtime probes, context formats, and help text. Rebuild it in the declared no-SELinux configuration tranche rather than translating excluded policy.

selection_policy: Cksum is isolated from b2sum because both compile cksum.c under different algorithm configurations. Its three ordinary captured units are translated while the exact cksum_crc.c object is retained as the typed CPU-dispatch bridge; the hybrid linker rejects every other canonical cksum member.
